proof_scope: Support-function formula for Hausdorff distance, ambient convex-body volume continuity, inner/outer volume limits; lattice-cell weighted Riemann sums under arbitrary lattice translations and o(k) outer boundary errors; count sandwich. Lower-dimensional bodies use zero ambient volume; dimension zero has one point. The complete proofs use only earlier internal separation/boundary-null and elementary measure convergence, with no general semigroup input.
